skill_name: Provide a solution to reduce pollution caused by burning oil.
workflow: One solution to reduce pollution caused by burning oil is to shift to renewable energy sources such as solar, wind, and geothermal sources. Renewable energy sources produce far fewer emissions than oil and have the potential to generate far more power, meaning that eventually oil burning can become obsolete.
